Verifier Roles
Verifiers operate independently and never share transient signature buffers.

Epoch Boundaries
Each epoch has a monotonic sequence number and a fixed 5-tick verification window.

Lease Backoff

renewal.

Batch Pipeline

check, and finally record an audit entry.

Audit Trail
